title: Northloop Payments: Payout Limit After a Bank Account Change
content:
**Rule.** The payout limit of a Northloop Payments scheduled payout is scaled by the new-bank payout-limit multiplier. The new-bank payout-limit multiplier is 0.04 when the payout bank account was changed no more than 30 calendar days before the payout date and the bank returned at least one payout from the account in the last twelve months; it is 0.10 when the bank account was changed no more than 30 calendar days before the payout date and the bank returned no payout from the account in the last twelve months; otherwise it is 1.

A window of the last twelve months takes in the ledger entries dated after the same calendar day twelve months before the payout date, up to and including the payout date.

## Records read

- **Bank change date** — the date on the payments account on which the current payout bank account was changed (verified); the days are counted in calendar days from that date to the payout date. An account with no bank change on record has no change within the 30 days.
- **Payouts returned by the bank** — the entries of payouts the bank returned to the account, counted over the last twelve months.

## Ladder

| Bank account changed no more than 30 calendar days before the payout date | Payouts returned by the bank in the last twelve months | New-bank payout-limit multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| yes | at least 1 | 0.04 |
| yes | none | 0.10 |
| no (changed more than 30 days before, or no change on record) | any number | 1 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, payout date P)

- Bank account changed on P less 30 calendar days: that is no more than 30 days, so the account is within the window; with no returned payout in twelve months the multiplier is 0.10.
- Bank account changed on P less 31 calendar days: more than 30 days, so the multiplier is 1 whatever the returned payouts.
- Bank account changed on P less 12 days, one payout returned by the bank eleven months before P: the return is inside the twelve-month window, so the multiplier is 0.04.
